name: rect
meaning: x, y, w, h of the scroll window, copied wholesale from the caller and replayed through Text_SetWindowRect on every Init/Step/Draw

name: text
meaning: the string being scrolled (overlay char * - the generator emits const char * as void *; ScrollText_Draw 0x539c0e and ScrollList_Update 0x539a3a add a byte offset to it)

name: topLine
meaning: index of the first visible wrapped line

name: maxTopLine
meaning: max(0, totalWrappedLines - font->rows); the scroll clamp

name: charOffset
meaning: byte offset into text of the first visible line, recomputed by summing Text_MeasureLine 0x533403 over topLine lines

name: scrollDir
meaning: pixels per frame of the smooth scroll in flight (negative = up, positive = down); 0 when idle

name: scrollPixels
meaning: accumulated sub-line pixel offset; the line commits when it reaches font->lineHeight or wraps to 0. Draw subtracts it from g_textCursorY
